The '''Kor Vella Medical Center''' was a small [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] in the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It had beds for several patients and medical equipment including a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]] to treat them.

Inexperienced [[Medic/Legends|medics]] would often seek out this facility to learn the necessary skills of their profession from experienced [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] and [[Medic/Legends|combat medics]].

==Behind the scenes==
This medical center is a building in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is not part of any quest in the game. In the early years of the game, players of the medic and doctor professions could heal other players' wounds in these buildings. Just being inside such a building would also slowly heal the player's wounds over time.

Before the Doctor and Combat Medic professions were removed from the game in 2005, trainer NPCs in the Medical Center could teach players of these professions new skills.
